scope: Gurk's six baseline use cases, supporting repairs, development tasks and test plan. Future Beta/Final work remains planned.

completionComments.body: The usage flow, chart and table design are published in VP revision 70. They define full-team usage, same-play-type league differences and small-sample flags. [Published model and diagrams](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/ce826f68e825f8d4c2a052a3c55c29e354d1d866/docs/alpha-release/model/README.md)

The defense flow and screen design are published in VP revision 70. They show positive league differences, supported Top 3 results and unavailable defensive categories. [Published model and diagrams](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/ce826f68e825f8d4c2a052a3c55c29e354d1d866/docs/alpha-release/model/README.md)

The usage comparison is deployed, and the coach view, sample cutoff and changed-filter checks passed. The matching model and release evidence are published. [Alpha release guide](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/ce826f68e825f8d4c2a052a3c55c29e354d1d866/docs/alpha-release/READ-ME.txt)

The opponent defense view is deployed and its coach, role and sample checks passed. The model now matches the screen and API. The outage-and-retry check was run locally. [Alpha release guide](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/ce826f68e825f8d4c2a052a3c55c29e354d1d866/docs/alpha-release/READ-ME.txt)

The usage comparison is complete. It keeps all play types visible, flags small samples and compares usage and PPP with the same play type across the league. Tests and the published VP design are linked in the release guide. [Alpha release guide](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/ce826f68e825f8d4c2a052a3c55c29e354d1d866/docs/alpha-release/READ-ME.txt)

The opponent view is complete. It ranks supported positive PPP differences, keeps raw allowed PPP visible and marks the four missing defensive categories unavailable. Tests and the published VP design are linked in the release guide. [Alpha release guide](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/ce826f68e825f8d4c2a052a3c55c29e354d1d866/docs/alpha-release/READ-ME.txt)

issues.title: Compare Usage and Efficiency
View Opponent Defensive Weak Spots
Compare Play Types with League Average
Track Play-Type Trends Across Seasons
Compare Head-to-Head Play-Type Profiles
View Possession Outcome Rates
Usage chart and table match team and league source totals
Sample cutoff flags rows without changing usage shares
Usage comparison clears outdated results and recovers after a failed request
Usage comparison enforces the intended user role
Regular-season team totals exclude playoff possessions
Field-goal rates use shot attempts instead of possessions
Duplicate source rows cannot double-count play-type possessions
Opponent weak spots use league-relative defensive efficiency
Small samples and missing defensive types cannot become weak spots
Opponent changes cannot leave the previous team's results on screen
Opponent defense view protects team data behind the intended role
A weaker opposing defense does not lower baseline predicted PPP
League benchmark preserves shooting and possession-rate denominators
Missing league categories remain unavailable
League comparison handles access and changing filters
Season trends match source totals in chronological order
Missing seasons create gaps rather than zero values
Trend filters and permissions stay consistent
Two-team profiles use the same season and matching categories
Swapping teams swaps labels and values without changing calculations
Profile comparison states its season-long scope and protects access
Outcome rates match possession-weighted source fields
Overlapping outcome rates are not normalized into a 100% stack
Invalid and missing outcome rates stay explicit
Compare a team's play-type usage and efficiency
